values.catalogue: An industrial gateway on MediaTek MT7628 with 4G dual-SIM, Wi-Fi 4, RS485, and an IP30-rated aluminium enclosure with DIN rail support. Ideal for industrial automation, remote asset monitoring, and small enterprise networks requiring dependable connectivity.

values.website:
Industrial Machine Data Communication
Remote Infrastructure Management
Smart Building Network Management
values.catalogue:
Industrial Machine Data Communication — Enables reliable connectivity between industrial controllers, sensors, and SCADA systems for remote data exchange and process visibility.
Remote Infrastructure Management — Suitable for monitoring remote infrastructure such as telecom shelters, street cabinets, and utility assets requiring stable cellular communication.
Smart Building Network Management — Can be deployed in smart buildings to connect access control systems, smart lighting, HVAC, and building automation devices through a centralized network.
